correctness.rationale: Explicit graph definitions and the cited 2013 original establish the common integer characteristic polynomial. A full characteristic-three derivation proves adjacency Jordan types F: J2(-1)+16J1(-1)+15J1(1) and H: J3(-1)+15J1(-1)+15J1(1); critical 13-vertex kernel powers have dimensions 6,7,8 and +1 eigenspace dimension 5. Each adjacency Jm(±1) induces a single temporal J2m at the appropriate eigenvalue. This establishes sharp order 18 and every fixed-time exponent with all quantifiers. Two actual executable packages confirm integer characteristic polynomials and 66-dimensional GF(3) matrix fixed-space counts, including six divisor-time checks for both graphs. Finite computations are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The 16-triangle friendship graph is the isolated 2013 spectral-rigidity exception, making its exceptional cospectral mate a mathematically motivated and canonical test of whether ordinary adjacency spectra determine temporal dynamics. A one-unit difference in modular Jordan extension length gives an exact full return-time census and explicit nonconjugacy despite equal global order. Unlike arbitrary finite-slice checking, this addresses a natural classical pair and a structural invariant inaccessible from the shared integer spectrum. The base friendship census and original graph construction are not credited as new.
